fields: h, cols, rows [{p, v, m, link, side}], fold, fold_noun, note. side: "out" puts a row on the leaving side (default: in). glyphs (optional): icon names for the train inside the boundary (default softener, carbon-filter, ro-membrane, edi, uv, tank). A row's link makes its name the link. Desktop shows every stream; the fold applies on phones, where the balance runs top to bottom: streams in, the boundary, streams out.
best_for: CostBalance draws what it costs to run a system as a balance around it: a dashed system boundary with the treatment train inside, every running cost a stream wired in from the left, the water that leaves (to drain) wired out to the right.
